filename: One-at-a-time Parameter Perturbation Ensemble of the Community Land Model, version 5.pdf
title: One-at-a-time Parameter Perturbation Ensemble of the Community Land Model, version 5.1
venue: Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems
testbed_rationale: Provides a comprehensive perturbed parameter ensemble of over 2000 global land simulations perturbing 211 parameters across 6 environmental forcing scenarios on a standardized 400-cell sparse grid, explicitly built to facilitate land model emulation, parameter calibration, and sensitivity analysis.
pain_points: High computational cost of standard Earth System land model spinups requiring special matrix-based semi-analytic spin-up (SASU) protocols.
Very high parameter space dimensionality (211 parameters perturbed) with complex interdependencies.
Extreme parameter values causing vegetation mortality (PFT eradication), requiring parameter range clipping.
Discovery of model code bugs (e.g., transposed nitrogen uptake parameters) post-ensemble generation.
Lack of land-atmosphere coupling feedbacks in land-only offline simulations.
extraction_notes: Multivariate spatio-temporal k-means clustering was employed as the unsupervised ML method to create the 400-cluster representative sparse grid. The PPE dataset itself serves as the benchmark foundation for model emulation and calibration algorithms.
